responsibility: Implements GCC’s C++ coroutine lowering at the front-end AST level. It collects per-function coroutine state, validates promise/handle protocol requirements, expands co_await/co_yield/co_return constructs, and transforms a user coroutine into the synthesized ramp, actor, and destroy functions plus the persistent coroutine frame, including promise construction, resume-state management, cleanup, and return-object handling.
